summary: Phase 1-3 admission and the repaired quarantine, authored-inventory, reachability, and Phase-2 receipt bindings pass at HEAD. Phase 4 remains security-blocked because the production acceptance validator ignores stop-loss observations and does not bind provider-resolved output hashes to receipt outputs; predecessor role evidence is also not yet a complete current five-role provenance set.

finding_details.title: Production Phase-4 validation ignores measured stop-loss observations
finding_details.detail: The validator checks actual_usage against ceilings but never reads or validates stop_loss_observations. A paired-control mutation with unsupported_factual_claims=1 returned {'ok': True}; replacing the entire stop_loss_observations object with null also returned {'ok': True}. This violates the frozen one-claim/one-mismatch stop contract and allows a breached or unmeasured role to reach acceptance.
finding_details.required_remediation: Validate the exact stop-loss key set and non-boolean integer values for every required role, reject any unsupported claim or denominator mismatch at or above the frozen threshold, enforce the two-cycle block and zero unresolved Critical/High/Medium findings, and add paired negative tests for missing, null, boolean, negative, and nonzero observations.

finding_details.title: Provider event output hashes are not bound to receipt outputs
finding_details.detail: The trusted-event comparison binds role/session/agent/prompt/context/final-response fields but omits the event's output_sha256. The later Git check proves receipt-declared bytes exist, not that the provider-resolved role event declared those outputs. A paired-control mutation replacing the provider event output map with a forged path/hash still returned {'ok': True}, permitting retrospective output attribution.
finding_details.required_remediation: Require exact equality between provider-resolved output_sha256 and the receipt output map before accepting the event, and add paired mutations for omitted, extra, stale, and forged provider output bindings.

finding_details.title: Current predecessor receipts do not prove the frozen five-role separation at the repaired HEAD
finding_details.detail: The evidence-collector receipt is now provider-attested and commit-bound, but discovery-auditor remains a retrospective handoff without measured actual_usage/stop-loss evidence, requirements-mapper attests an earlier reconciliation under role reconciliation-integrator and explicitly does not attest commit 32069ccd, and no truth-test-author receipt exists. The shell receipt-integrity guard reports only current output-hash coverage and one OpenCode manifest; it does not prove this track's complete current role provenance.
finding_details.required_remediation: Before adversarial review, obtain truthful provider-resolved receipts for every applicable predecessor role, including exact role identity, prompt/context/final-response events, measured ceilings and stop-loss observations, and output hashes at their actual owning commits. Do not retrofit unavailable event facts.

resolved_prior_findings.resolution: Commit 6dda411b filters the failed-track prefix from historical searches and Phase-2 factual outputs. Live Phase-2 and Phase-3 quarantine tests pass.
Commit 6dda411b derives program identities from frozen source/ledger/history evidence rather than the prior authored PROGRAM_IDENTITIES constant. The dedicated anti-hard-coding test passes.
The production Phase-4 validator now exists and its paired Green-branch counterexamples execute against a temporary committed fixture; 25/25 counterexamples passed.
